meta.label: Roster replanned to comply
meta.notes: Stylised Mumbai hub operation across the week of 2-8 December 2025, used as the framework's demonstration case. The timetable is synthetic and the duty rules are a reconstruction; see parameters below.

parameters.name: fdtl_cut
parameters.note: Fitted jointly with congestion feedback to four published outcomes

parameters.name: crews_per_aircraft
parameters.note: Set so the pre-change week runs clean; only the 7.6:9.1 ratio is sourced

parameters.name: duty_lines_per_day
parameters.note: Consequence of the roster cap applied to this timetable

parameters.name: regulation
parameters.value: dgca-style-2025-post-calibrated; duty ≤ 11.3 h; ≤ 4 legs; rest ≥ 12 h; ≤ 60 h per 7 d; night −60 min; 2 day(s) off in 7
parameters.note: reconstruction, not transcribed from the circular
